The buggy method is:

`org.apache.commons.lang3.text.translate.EntityArrays.ISO8859_1_ESCAPE()`

Diagnosis:
- The failing test checks that both columns of the returned `String[][]` contain unique values.
- `ISO8859_1_ESCAPE()` itself only returns a clone of the backing static array, so the real fault is in the data exposed by this method.
- Static inspection of the backing field `ISO8859_1_ESCAPE` shows corrupted/misaligned entries in the lowercase section:
  - `{"\u00DF", "Þ"}` should correspond to uppercase thorn earlier; `\u00DF` should map to `ß`
  - `{"\u00E0", "ß"}`
  - `{"\u00E1", "à"}`
  - ...
  - `{"\u00E5", "ä"}`
  - `{"\u00E5", "å"}`
- This creates a duplicate first-column key `"\u00E5"`, which directly explains why `col0.add(sa[i][0])` returns `false` and the assertion fails.
- The pattern also indicates an off-by-one shift in mappings starting around `\u00DF`, so this is not just one duplicate but a data table corruption.

Dynamic verification was inconclusive due to debugger session loss, but the static evidence is sufficient and directly matches the test failure mode.
